title: Dean Wilson Junior Golf Classic, Nakaoka wins 2nd straight Classic Title - NewsBreak
text:
The final day of the 2025 HSJGA Dean Wilson Junior Golf Classic was held at the Pali Golf Course on Wednesday. More than 80 golfers signed up to play this year, which had 6 different age bracket divisions (up from 4 last year). The Tournament had prizes and raffles for the athletes which included a signed surfboard from Kelly Slater. For the Tournament, Mililani grad and Oregon State Signee Kate Nakaoka came away with the win in the Girls 15-18 Flight. “It’s super special because I’ve been playing it just tournaments for, I want to say, about seven or eight years. So it’s just been a lot of HSJGA tournaments and just glad to end on a win,” said Nakaoka. The Former Trojan came into the final day sitting 4 over par but had an extraordinary second day as Nakaoka shot 6 under par to finish 2 under and secure the win. “I knew I was four strokes back after the first day and I had nothing to lose, so I was just doing whatever I could to work my way up.
It was just an amazing experience and it’s super fun to play. Even though I didn’t play great on day 1,” said Nakaoka. For the great Dean Wilson, seeing these young athletes show up and perform is something he doesn’t take for granted. “The various tournaments growing, we had 84 kids sign up and last year we had about 50. So definitely growing and watching all the keiki out here, having fun just warms my heart. It’s awesome when I’m watching and I see the swings and how far they’re hitting it and what they’re doing. It’s a lot different than when I was a junior,” said Wilson. As for the rest of the winners: BOYS FLIGHT 11-12: – Carter Crouse GIRLS FLIGHT 11-12: – Lucy Cui BOYS FLIGHT 13-14: – Caleb Ito GIRLS FLIGHT 13-14: – Brooke Asao BOYS FLIGHT 15-18: – Taylor George GIRLS FLIGHT 15-18: – Kate Nakaoka For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to KHON2.
